workflowDefinition.description: Chaos Commerce returns. Looks the order up, runs a bounded loop of pointless checks whose verdicts are recorded and ignored, waits for the manager's break to end, then applies the real returns policy. It always ends with a decision of APPROVED, STORE_CREDIT or DENIED: every worker step is optional and bounded, there is no step that waits on a human, and a server-side settle step decides if the Returns Desk worker does not.
